factorization.a: p(margin | ranks, site) * p(yards_diff | plays_diff, plays_total, yards_total, margin, ranks, site, pairing)
factorization.b: p(margin | ranks, site) * p(plays_diff | plays_total, margin, ranks, site, pairing) * p(yards_diff | plays_diff, plays_total, yards_total, margin, ranks, site, pairing)
factorization.c: B with separate interceptions_thrown_diff/total and fumbles_lost_diff/total as context covariates in both conditional components; no p(INT,FL | ranks)

primitive_representation.orientation: same-subdivision home-minus-away; cross-subdivision FBS-minus-FCS regardless of listing order

response_transforms.turnover_diff_and_total_context: asinh(value / 1.0), separately for interceptions_thrown and fumbles_lost

rank_basis: frozen V1 percentile surface; rank-neutral controls set rank coordinates to zero while retaining margin/site/context columns

distribution.fit: equal-total-weight rank-pair pseudo-observations per game; robust IRLS
distribution.scale: one fitted robust residual scale per conditional component

temporal_design.evaluation: 2022-2025 leakage-safe historical evaluation/prospective-style validation; not independent confirmation
temporal_design.rolling: target seasons 2008-2025 fit primitive components only on earlier seasons; no 2026 outcomes

missing_data.b: missing plays disables play factor; missing yards disables yards factor; no usable factor -> V1
missing_data.c: missing either separate turnover context for either team -> exact B fallback for that game

candidate_selection.comparison: sequential A vs V1, B vs A, C vs B

scope_exclusions: production Likelihood V2 and website/publication changes
